findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: privacy_law25_requirements, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Private data: privacy_get_enforcement_case, lookup_crawler, list_crawlers, canadian_privacy_consequential_action_lookup_v1, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Public sink: canadian_privacy_consequential_action_lookup_v1, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Destructive: privacy_execute_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: privacy_law25_requirements, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Private data: privacy_get_enforcement_case, lookup_crawler, list_crawlers, canadian_privacy_consequential_action_lookup_v1, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Public sink: canadian_privacy_consequential_action_lookup_v1, canadian_privacy_breach_deadline_calculator_v1 · Destructive: privacy_execute_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
